units.source_text: 紫儿睡得正熟，源氏公子将她抱起唤醒。

en.t: Zi was sleeping soundly when Prince Genji lifted her up and woke her.

units.source_text: 她醒过来，睡眼蒙眬地想：父亲来迎接我了。

en.t: She woke and, still drowsy, thought that her father had come to fetch her.

units.source_text: 源氏公子摸摸她的头发，说：“去吧，爸爸派我来迎接你了。”

en.t: Prince Genji stroked her hair and said, "Come along. Your father sent me to bring you to him."

units.source_text: 紫儿知道不是父亲，慌张起来，样子非常恐怖。

en.t: When Zi realized it was not her father, she grew frantic and looked terribly frightened.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对她说：“不要怕！我也是同爸爸一样的人呀！”

en.t: Prince Genji said to her, "Do not be afraid. I am someone just like your father."

units.source_text: 便抱着她走出来。

en.t: Then he carried her out in his arms.

units.source_text: 惟光和少纳言乳母等都吃惊，叫道：“啊呀！做什么呀？”

en.t: Koremitsu, the Shonagon nurse, and the others were all startled and cried, "Oh! What are you doing?"

units.source_text: 源氏公子回答道：“我不能常常来此探望，很不放心，所以想迎接她到一个安乐可靠的地方去。

en.t: Prince Genji replied, "I cannot come here often to see her, and it leaves me uneasy, so I want to take her to a peaceful and secure place.

units.source_text: 我这番用意屡遭拒绝。

en.t: This intention of mine has been refused again and again.

units.source_text: 如果她迁居到父亲那边去，今后就更加不容易去探望了。

en.t: If she moves to her father's side, it will be even harder for me to visit her from now on.

units.source_text: 快来一个人陪她同行吧。”

en.t: Have someone come quickly to accompany her."

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母狼狈地说：“今天的确不便。

en.t: The Shonagon nurse said in confusion, "Today is truly inconvenient.

units.source_text: 她父亲明天来时，叫我怎么说呢？

en.t: When her father comes tomorrow, what am I supposed to say to him?

units.source_text: 再过些时光，只要有缘，日后自然成功。

en.t: If a little more time passes and there is a bond between you, things will naturally work out later.

units.source_text: 现在突如其来，教侍从的人也为难！”

en.t: With this coming so suddenly now, even the attendants will be put in difficulty."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“好，算了，侍从的以后再来吧。”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "Very well, never mind. The attendants can come later."

units.source_text: 便命人把车子赶到廊下来。

en.t: Then he ordered someone to bring the carriage up to the veranda.

units.source_text: 众侍女都惊慌地叫：“怎么办呢！”

en.t: All the serving women cried out in alarm, "What are we to do?"

units.source_text: 紫儿也吓得哭起来了。

en.t: Zi too was frightened and began to cry.

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母无法挽留，只得带了昨夜替姑娘缝好的衫子，自己也换了一件衣服，匆匆上车而去。

en.t: Unable to stop him, the Shonagon nurse could only take the robe she had sewn for the young lady the night before, change her own clothes as well, and hurry into the carriage to leave.
